lines.en: label dormwarsfive10:
scene postcomedytwo1
: Hahah! Touka sure is funny! Isn’t she, guys?
: She, uhh...really laid into you for a second there, Ami.
: How’d you manage to piss off a rich girl so badly anyway? You have so much practice with Ayane.
: Did you really tell Touka she’s never had to work for anything? That girl’s pretty much always studying something.
: Hell, even being outside of her mansion and conversing with people like us is studying to her.
: Oh, so you’re just not rich anymore? Maybe that’s why Ami’s attempt fell flat then.
scene postcomedytwo2
: I may have accidentally tried to intimidate her out of spending time with Sensei. I never thought she’d call me out in front of literally everyone, though.
: I’m actually kind of impressed. Maybe she’s cooler than I thought?
: So you’re not going to try and poison her then?
scene postcomedytwo3
: Poison her? Because she made fun of me? People make fun of me all the time and I’ve never poisoned any of them.
: Right...It’s not the “making fun of you” part I’m worried about, though.
: Then what-
: It’s that stuff she said about Sensei and him apparently seeing her as his mother. That toes too many of your lines for you to just shrug it off and laugh about it.
: It’s a comedy show, Ayane. None of it’s serious. Like, why do you think everyone still talks to Sensei even after Tsuneyo alluded to him jerking off on Molly’s unconscious body?
scene postcomedytwo4
: Ami! That’s-
: Probably because everyone in this class has already deluded themselves into thinking he can do no wrong and will eventually love them if they try hard enough to make him.
scene postcomedytwo5
: You’re one to talk.
: No, I’m different. I fully acknowledge that he’s a terrible person and that I’m an idiot for liking him. I’m just also a bad person, so it makes sense for us to fuck each other.
: That’s...the whole Molly thing is...there’s a lot we never found out and...don’t understand. That’s different.
scene postcomedytwo6
: Are you saying you’d stop loving him if it wasn’t, though?
: In fact, is there anything Sensei could do to make you or anyone else love him less? Or is it kind of like that aspect of your personalities is already set in stone?
: Like me.
: Yeah. Like how it is for Maya.
scene postcomedytwo7
: Don’t look so down, Ayane! I’m not trying to make you feel bad. The whole point of this was to remind you that comedy is comedy.
: And that, sometimes, people exaggerate the truth or say things they don’t fully mean in the heat of the moment.
: Like when you threatened to dismember the entire class for getting close to Sensei?
: No, I meant that.
: I just...don’t want you trying to get back at her or anything. Touka’s not the type to want to hurt anyone. And if that’s really the way Sensei sees her-
: Then she has already hurt him.
scene postcomedytwo8
: And I’ll act as I see fit in order to protect him from being hurt any more!
: Assuming there’s a speck of truth to it and that it wasn’t all just comedy, of course. But that’s something I can ask my dad about on my own time.
: Until then, Touka can continue to be a rich, father-stealing whore all she wants!
scene postcomedytwo9
: Maya! Come to the restroom with me?
: Yeah. There’s no problem with that, right?
: I’ll go with you, Ami.
scene postcomedytwo10
: Unless there’s a reason you’re asking Maya and not me.
: Are you trying to accuse me of something, Ayane?
: I...don’t really know...what’s going on.
: You’ve just been acting kind of weird lately. And I don’t want you getting overly-emotional over some comedic jabs from Touka that quite obviously-
scene postcomedytwo11
: Maya, restroom?
: Okay.
scene black
: Guys-
: Be back in a few, Ayane! Let’s all walk to the hotel together afterwards!

label sanasanasana:
scene postcomedytwo12
: Sana! You finally came to say hi to me! I was worried I looked too young behind the counter and you confused me for a new part-timer.
: You don’t look that young...I was just talking to my friends.
scene postcomedytwo13
: Who’s...working at the bar right now? Yuki hasn’t come back, has she?
scene postcomedytwo14
: No...Yuki has not come back.
: So nobody’s there right now. And Haru-chan needed help for your Dorm Wars thing, so I decided to lend a hand here and just close up shop for the weekend.
: The...whole weekend? So tomorrow-
: You don’t have to worry about coming in. I’m gonna take the night off and watch movies. But if you want to come over and hang out with me-
scene postcomedytwo15
: I...have plans tomorrow, so...sorry...
: Oh! Well...that’s fine. Girls will be girls. Just have fun and...be safe, dear.
: I’ll try, but...I do feel bad, Mom.
: About what, Sana?
: About...not spending much time with you lately.
: I miss you.
scene postcomedytwo16
: You...what?
: I miss you...and I’m really thankful you’re my mom.
: Am I dreaming right now?
: Is it...that unbelievable to hear me say that?
: Yes. And I’m not allowed to be this happy, so there is clearly an ulterior motive at play here.
scene postcomedytwo17
: Well, there is...something I could use a little help with...but it’s a little embarrassing, so...
: There’s no need to be embarrassed, dear. Just tell me. I’d do anything for you, Sana.
: You...really mean that, Mom?
: Of course...
: Then...um...
scene postcomedytwo18
: I’ve been struggling with math, so...
: Could you maybe...help me earn a little extra credit tomorrow night? Since you don’t...have anything else to do?
: Uh...h...how?
: By...convincing Sensei to maybe...bump my grades up a little bit in exchange for...something?
: You’re...okay with that...right? I mean...it shouldn’t be hard for you since...he already talks about you all the time...
: And I...know you guys are already...you know...
: Is that...okay...Mom?...
: Did he put you up to this?
: Sensei? Of course not. He would never...
: This is...my idea...and...
: It doesn’t bother me...if it’s you...
scene postcomedytwo19
: I’ll...see what I can do. But you should be trying harder in school, Sana. Relying on me to make up for you is-
: Yeah. I’ll try harder. This is just a one-time thing. Sorry, Mom.
: ...It’s okay, baby. Anything I can do to make things easier.
scene black
: That makes me...really happy...
jump dormwarsfivetenend
label dormwarsfivetenend:
scene postcomedytwo20
: Sensei! Now that Imani is no longer paying attention, I am here to confirm that you- Nodoka.
: I — Akira. This — Nodoka.
: Is she asleep?
: It appears that way, yes.
: I didn’t realize she could do that.
scene postcomedytwo21
: Yeah...she’s been acting kind of weird all day. So I figured I’d just let her rest since it might be the only time this year she actually gets to.
: Huh...She’s actually really cute when she’s not making everyone around her feel bad about themselves.
scene postcomedytwo22
: Anyway! I am here to confirm if you are still-
scene postcomedytwo23
: Hey, homie! I don’t have a phone anymore, so I need to verbally confirm what time we’re meeting up for our date thingy tomorrow.
: I appear to be currently useless!
: You mean the date that I am definitely not coming to because all adults are banned from day two of the Dorm Wars this year?
: Imani’s talking to Futaba right now, so you can be honest.
: Then I guess whenever I’m done with Io. She’s first, right?
scene postcomedytwo24
: Correct! And as Io’s attorney, I must first inform you that I-
: What’s up with Nodoka?
: Will go fuck myself, apparently!
scene postcomedytwo25
: I think she might have grown feelings.
: I didn’t realize she could do that.
scene postcomedytwo26
: Either way! Whenever you’re done with your totally normal Io date, just come over here.
: I have an appointment in the morning, but I’m picking up a short shift after that while I wait around for you.
scene postcomedytwo27
: Doctor again? Is everything-
: Everything’s fine. No need to worry. Just show up and I’ll handle everything from there.
: Will you take it easy on Io, Rin? She’s never been on a date before, so it’ll be totally unfair if you just get freaky with Sensei and win that way.
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about that. I’ve blue-balled this guy more than anyone. Which is probably why I’m currently facing karmic retribution. But that’s another story.
: Can I hear it?
: Maybe when you’re older.
: I’m literally older than you.
scene black
: Well then maybe you should act like it.
: Defamation! Retract that statement or I’ll sue you and you’ll be forced to hire me to defend you since I’m the only defense counsel in town!
: Guys, be quiet. You’re going to wake up Nodoka and she’s going to go back to normal.
scene clearnightsky
Everything was going well and normal and fine and good except for the fact that it wasn’t.
Because just several blocks away from a room where everyone was laughing and drinking coffee and wanting to fuck some dude, there was a girl who wasn’t doing any of that.
scene postcomedytwo28
Isn’t that right, Yumi? You don’t want Akira to fuck your brains out. You’re too busy being upset about your dying mom or whatever.
: I don’t give a shit about her. Never have, never will. Bitch was probably planning on dying without giving me a heads up anyway.
Cool, yeah. So about all that hot teacher sex you’re going to have-
scene postcomedytwo29
: Can you please shut the fuck up about that?
: It sucks enough having a voice inside of my head that can actually hold a conversation. The last thing I need is it pressuring me to fuck my friend’s boyfriend.
Right. But she’s not really your friend anymore. And she’d be totally fine with you getting your back blown out so long as it’s because of love or whatever.
: I don’t love him...and I definitely don’t want to fuck him.
I can read your fucking thoughts, idiot. I live inside of your head. I know what you masturbate to.
: Everybody fucking does that, okay? Fantasy is fantasy. And it might be news to you, but shit that happens inside of a person’s head is normally meant to stay there.
Yeah, that is news to me. Most people cave the second they have a chance to blame their actions on someone else. Maybe a cool disembodied voice or something?
: Most people? So you’re not my own personal demon? You’re out tormenting everyone?
Not everyone. Just the interesting ones. Who have something to offer in exchange for my guidance.
: Is Chika one of ‘em? You the thing that made her go cock-crazy too?
Not...technically? Though maybe inadvertently. But hey! She’s happy now, isn’t she? Or happier than you at least.
: Can’t imagine that’s very hard right now.
Yeah. People tend to suffer when they hold themselves back from what they want the most. But there’s a very easy way to change that, Yumi.
Fuck your teacher! Join the party! Everybody’s doing it! It’s the only way to get rid of me!
: Bullshit. You ain’t gonna fuckin’ bail just because I spread my legs for some pervert.
No, probably not. But it would be nice to see that faux-furious facade crumble beneath the weight of a massive, throbbing-
scene postcomedytwo30
: For the love of fucking-
scene postcomedytwo31
: Oh...Yumi.
: That’s good. I thought those Yakuza guys were back for a second.
: Yakuza guys?
Don’t talk to her. She’s boring. Plus — she made fun of you that one time when you decided to be vulnerable. Remember? You don’t like her.
: Yeah, but I don’t like anyone. And she’s better than you, at least.
Wait. Yumi-
scene postcomedytwo32
: The fuck you doing over here? Shouldn’t you be at the cafe with everyone else?
: Me? Have you missed so much time in school that you’ve forgotten my key defining trait is never wanting to be around any of you?
: Have you forgotten mine is threatening to beat you up and take your lunch money or whatever the fuck people assume I’m gonna do when I approach them?
: Why ain’t you running away? Why don’t you seem scared?
: Would it be weird to say I can smell when someone wants to take something from me?
: Little bit, yeah.
: Okay. I’ll just keep my mouth shut then. And you can do the same. And we can both go back to not liking each other and forget you ever approached me at all.
scene postcomedytwo33
: Works for me. Was just thinkin’ I could use some peace and quiet.
: So you...decided to walk up to someone else? Would it not have made more sense to just mind your own business and forget you saw me?
: It would, yeah. Not for me, though. Least not anymore. But you’d call me a fuckin’ lunatic if I actually explained any of it. So I second that whole “shut our fuckin’ mouths” thing.
scene postcomedytwo34
: Cool. Though, I still don’t understand why you have to be near me for it.
: I guess your presence will deter worse people, though. So it makes sense for me to not ask you to leave so long as you don’t speak to me.
: You sure talk a lot for somebody who doesn’t wanna talk.
: I’m not the only hypocrite here when you’re a self-proclaimed lone wolf who wastes no time at all in approaching one more animal without a pack.
: The way you word that makes it sound like you’d want to join one when we both know there ain’t a pack who’d wanna take you in the first place.
: No, I guess there’s not...
: There are a few other wolves who keep helping me, though. When it would make much more sense to just leave me for dead.
: You talkin’ about your short-stack friend you’ve got a fuckin’ hard-on for again?
: Uta, yes.
: And Yuki.
scene postcomedytwo35
: Yuki doesn’t give a shit about-
: She might have saved my life the other day.
scene postcomedytwo36
: ...What?
: I could just be overreacting — but I’m pretty sure these two Yakuza dudes wanted to take turns raping me behind a rollercoaster.
scene postcomedytwo37
: But then Yuki showed up out of nowhere and kicked their asses. And nobody raped me behind a rollercoaster. Which is a good thing.
: ...Yeah. I think “good” might be puttin’ it lightly, though.
: Did that really happen?
: It did. But I haven’t seen her around ever since. And she looked kind of horrible when she did show up, so I’m currently pretty worried about her.
: Can you confirm that she’s still alive?
scene postcomedytwo38
: Think so.
: For now, at least.
: Check back in a week or two and see what I say then.
: What’s she on this time?
: Nothing as far as I know. Doesn’t make much of a difference either way now that she’s got cancer, though.
scene postcomedytwo39
: She’s...huh?
: Oh. Surprise. Guess you hadn’t heard.
: Yuki...has cancer? What kind? Do you know how serious-
: I don’t know shit. And I ain’t in a hurry to find out either. Let her fuckin’ die for all I care. Gives me one less thing to worry about.
scene postcomedytwo40
: You were right to laugh at me back in her apartment. Fuckin’ dumb that I let myself get wrapped up in any of that emotional bullshit to begin with.
: Should’ve kicked her ass the moment she came back into my life. Not doin’ that just set me up for failure in the end.
: Now all I can do is try and get back to the real me. The one who doesn’t give a shit about anyone but herself. Who can’t get hurt by shit like that.
: You ain’t gonna say shit about how sorry you are or anything like that, are you? Cause it ain’t gonna do anything.
: I don’t...really know what to say. I’m not sure there are any words for it.
: No, probably not.
: Which is why I liked your idea — that we just stand here, not sayin’ shit until we’ve each got our fill of self-inflicted loneliness.
scene black
: Parents fucking suck, don’t they?
: ...yeah.
: Yeah...they really do.
scene postcomedytwo41
: Touka, sorry to ask this now that everything has blown over — but don’t you think you might have been a little too hard on Ami back there?
: Not Kirin, though. It’s okay to point out her issues because those are funny.
: If it appeared as if I was targeting her directly, I can assure you that is only...partially true.
: It’s just that the act of stand-up comedy is usually based on the real accounts of those performing it.
: And Ami’s existence is comical enough from my perspective to tell jokes about — specifically after she attempts to intimidate me into abandoning Sensei.
: That’s just a thing Ami does, though. She’s not all there. And even if everything you said is true, putting her on blast is, like...kind of mean, isn’t it?
: I do not think so. But the Emerald Guardian would likely beg to differ as I put her in a similar predicament when it was my turn to be hilarious.
scene postcomedytwo42
: I like Ami a lot. And I’m not just saying that because I am now on the list of people who have kissed her.
: But to mock her openly is to insult the Supreme Overlord’s character as well as he is her official caretaker.
: Well, perhaps he should do a better job? I can’t even fathom how Mother would punish me if I were to abuse my status to bully others into submission.
: That’s like, all you did for the first month you were here.
: Yes. But I have learned and she has not.
: Is it not wrong that we constantly allow her to push us all around because of who she is to our teacher? Should we just submit to whatever she wants whenever she wants it?
scene postcomedytwo43
: I don’t believe so.
: And I fear that merely ignoring her is not conducive to her improving as a person if she is going to try and quarrel with anyone her uncle- sorry, father shows a single iota of interest in.
: It’s not that I disagree with any of that, Touka. I have just as many reasons to want to knock her down a peg. She’s just...not like us.
: Neither is Touka, though. So maybe it’s good if we let them go at it?
scene postcomedytwo44
: Like, maybe it fuels some sort of rivalry that builds up sexual tension between them and they wind up falling in love with each other while I get Sensei?
: Ew.
: Unlikely. I have slandered so many people and yet none of them have kissed me.
: Perhaps an...apology would be in order? Even if somewhat...insincere?
scene postcomedytwo45
: I shan’t apologize for speaking my mind. But I am more than willing to have a formal  discussion with Ami if she so pleases.
scene black
: Until then, I find it best that we remain focused on the task at hand.
: That the girls of the second floor walk away from this battle victorious...
scene postcomedytwo46
: Finally, some peace and quiet.
scene postcomedytwo47
: Aki-kun, Aki-kun, Aki-kun!
: I never should have opened my mouth.
: This whole Dorm Wars thing sure is fun, isn’t it? Twenty teenagers fighting over control of your dick? That sounds like a dream come true!
: It can be fun when they don’t all want to kill each other. Or when they don’t reveal embarrassing things about me.
scene postcomedytwo48
: What — you’re embarrassed that rich girl said you see her as a mother? Why?
: Probably because the last woman I saw as a mother routinely sucked me off in the backseat of her car before dying in an accident.
: That doesn’t sound embarrassing at all. Very sad, yes. But embarrassing? No. And I’m willing to suck you off again right now to prove it.
: That proves literally nothing to no one.
: We won’t know until we try.
scene postcomedytwo49
: Sekai, why are you wearing Nodoka’s clothes? You know I don’t like it when you cosplay as people I actually know.
: Well it’s only fair, isn’t it? She gets to wear my daughter’s clothes and I get to wear hers. An eye for an eye and all that stuff.
: Plus, I can just smell that something is going on with her right now. I bet it’s good too. Finding out someone loves you can change your world. Can’t it, Aki-kun?
: Yes, but it’s rarely for the better.
: You say that now because you’ve experienced great despair! But if I were still alive-
: If you were still alive, you’d still be fucking my brother and I’d be literally nothing because that’s all I ever was when I was with you.
: And it’s all I am now, too. But at least I can look back on those years after you died and-
scene postcomedytwo50
: And barely see anything at all because you’ve repressed it.
: Face the facts, Aki-kun. If I don’t die, you get to grow up. Into a big strong man who fucks full-grown adult women! What a world that would be, right?
: But instead — you get this.
: You get a world that mirrors who you really are. One where you can’t make a choice because you're scared of what happens if you choose incorrectly.
: So you stand there and let it swallow you — patiently waiting for someone else to make a decision on your behalf, then doubting them when they do.
: How can a person like that win at all? No matter what happens, you’re always going to be wondering about how things would be if they played out a little differently.
: And why are you here, Sekai? Why are you in this world? Because I want you to be?
: I like to think my love for you is just so strong that it defies death. Some may call it “haunting,” but I think that sounds a little negative. Don’t you?
: Besides — it’s not like I only show up for you in the first place! Just ask the ramen girl!
: I don’t need to when she already told me about you.
: Oooooh? And what did she say?
: Something I don’t want to repeat.
: Because it makes you hard?
: Because it makes me sick.
: But it would be totally fine if it was you instead, right? You’d sleep like a baby if you got to fuck her first.
: You’re not even alive, Sekai!
scene postcomedytwo51
: Which is why it doesn’t count! And why she’s still a virgin that you get to claim whenever you please. I just gave you both a little push.
: We didn’t need a push...
scene postcomedytwo52
: You sure did, Aki-kun. If I let the two of you just carry on the way you were, it’d take you trillions of years to penetrate her. Now? A year or two at most.
: Probably less if you stop being such a pussy about it.
scene postcomedytwo49
: Ooh, I know! Want me to go “haunt” her? It wouldn’t take much convincing at all to get her over here. Her father owes me. I can call in a favor.
: I want you to leave...that’s it.
: Big day tomorrow, huh? A date with a girl who hates sex and a girl who’s fascinated by it. And that’s not even counting whatever it is my new favorite has in store.
: Leave!
scene postcomedytwo51
: No!
: LEAVE!
scene postcomedytwo53

END OF NIGHT ONE.
